description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

Your appearance degrades into some nightmarish apparition - so terrifying that your mere visage challenges the sanity of onlookers. You're free to use your imagination as to what exactly makes you so horrendous. You could be monstrous (reptilian, spiderlike...), rotten (Nurgle, zombie...), eldritch (think Chtulhu...), daemonic and so on. You cause @Terror[1] and your Fellowship can never be higher than 0. This mutation can only be gained once.
